description: Third-party code vendored in (or fetched by) the SatDump tree. One entry per library. A PR that changes a listed path must update that library's entry. Fields are described in CONTRIBUTING.md; tools/check_third_party.py validates the file.

libraries.name: Dear ImGui
libraries.version_source: IMGUI_VERSION in imgui.h and the v1.93.0 tag. Every listed file was compared with the tag: imgui.cpp, imgui.h, imgui_demo.cpp, imgui_draw.cpp, imgui_internal.h, imgui_tables.cpp, imgui_widgets.cpp, the imstb_* headers and imgui_stdlib.cpp/.h (from misc/cpp) are identical, the others differ only by the local changes.

local_changes.details: imconfig.h defines IMGUI_DEFINE_MATH_OPERATORS and ImDrawIdx as unsigned int. The src-ui backends include "imgui/imgui.h" instead of "imgui.h", and imgui_impl_opengl3.cpp also includes "gl3w/gl3w.h" (unless IMGUI_IMPL_OPENGL_ES2).

libraries.notes: ImPlot, ImPlot3D, imnodes, imgui_markdown, gl3w and portable-file-dialogs have their own entries. The Android backends (imgui-android-backends) must be updated together with the core. Since 1.92.9, scalar inputs (InputInt, InputScalar, Drag, Slider) only write the typed value back when it is validated, unless ImGuiItemFlags_LiveEditOnInputScalar is set (common/widgets/datetime.cpp sets it). Since 1.92.8 the OpenGL 3 backend binds its own linear sampler, overriding the filters of SatDump's image textures: src-ui/backend.cpp and android/backend.cpp call useImageTextureFilters() (imgui_image.h) every frame, which adds DrawCallback_SetSamplerFromTex. Since 1.93.0 AddRect() / AddRectFilled() draw nothing with inverted coordinates.

libraries.name: Dear ImGui Android backends
libraries.version_source: The backends of the v1.93.0 tag, the same as the core. Before that update they were imgui_impl_android from v1.90.1 and imgui_impl_opengl3 from a master snapshot between v1.89.9 and v1.90.

local_changes.details: All files include "imgui/imgui.h" instead of "imgui.h". imgui_impl_android.cpp/.h: a long press of 0.5 s generates a right click (procLongPress(), called by android/backend.cpp, uses satdump::getTime() from utils/time.h), and stylus and mouse touches are handled like fingers (S-Pen support), except that only finger touches reset the mouse position when lifted.

libraries.notes: Android only. Must be updated to the same version as the core. imgui_impl_opengl3_loader.h is unused, as Android builds with IMGUI_IMPL_OPENGL_ES3.

libraries.name: nlohmann/json
libraries.version_source: NLOHMANN_JSON_VERSION_* in json.hpp; the commit is the v3.12.0 tag. json.hpp is the v3.12.0 single-include release asset (SHA-256 aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63, identical to single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp at the tag), apart from the local changes below.

local_changes.details: The ignore_comments default is true instead of false in the lexer, the lexer's ignore_comments member, sax_parse, parse and accept (12 places), so SatDump's JSON files may contain // and /* */ comments. The original change (c89c7b8b9) also set the detail::parser skip_comments default; that 13th spot is intentionally not carried, because basic_json::parser() always passes it explicitly and nothing constructs detail::parser directly.

libraries.notes: Updated in #278 from a develop snapshot taken after v3.11.3 (upstream 4f64d8d0b4f3783256c1d8597682d75c3ea587b9, identical apart from the ignore_comments defaults). v3.12.0 converts std::filesystem::path to and from UTF-8 on all platforms (previously the native narrow encoding on Windows) and adds std::optional conversions under C++17.

libraries.name: AngelScript
libraries.version_source: ANGELSCRIPT_VERSION_STRING in angelscript.h and the v2.39.0 tag of the official repository (https://github.com/anjo76/angelscript; home page https://www.angelcode.com/angelscript/). lib/ holds sdk/angelscript/source plus sdk/angelscript/include/angelscript.h, which is also copied to src-core/angelscript/angelscript.h; the four add-on directories are from sdk/add_on. Every file was compared with the tag: all are identical except for the local changes below. The tag's contents also match angelscript_2.39.0.zip from angelcode.com, apart from line endings (most files in the zip use CRLF, the tag uses LF).

local_changes.details: as_config.h includes "../angelscript.h" instead of "../include/angelscript.h", and defines AS_MAX_PORTABILITY on __APPLE__ (macOS fix from f3a337bff). The add-on headers scriptarray.h, scriptbuilder.h, scriptdictionary.h and scriptstdstring.h include "angelscript/angelscript.h" instead of <angelscript.h>. parseFloat() in scriptstdstring.cpp tests __ANDROID__ instead of ANDROID before using newlocale()/uselocale() (from 1d24985aa). Upstream 2.39.0 already has the fix for the misplaced #endif in parseFloat() (bfa326caf) and supersedes the as_callfunc_arm_gcc.S part of 1d24985aa.

libraries.notes: Add-ons scriptarray, scriptbuilder, scriptdictionary and scriptstdstring are from the AngelScript SDK; scriptsatdump is SatDump's own. lib/as_callfunc_x64_msvc_clang.S (new in 2.39.0, for Clang on Windows without MSVC) is vendored but not built: src-core/CMakeLists.txt only adds the assembly files it lists. Since 2.39.0 asITypeInfo::GetTypedefTypeId() is only available with AS_DEPRECATED; use GetUnderlyingTypeId() (scriptsatdump/dump_predef.cpp does). Updated in #282 from a mixed copy: lib/ was SVN r3022 (upstream e3569f97c8dc9e8bc09043141618bef3ffa90fd3, 2025-04-07, 2.38.0 WIP; matched by diffing upstream history), and the add-ons were from the 2.38.0 release (535fa4e13037c659e726dcfac8791b19da463360, "Releasing 2.38.0"; the v2.38.0 tag, 0601da029d846a658bf23f2888e953a45a94450a, only adds README.md). Behaviour change from an upstream fix (365b8fb5): converting a runtime double above 2^31 to uint now gives the right value, e.g. 3000000000 where the old copy gave 2147483648.

libraries.name: muparser
libraries.version_source: ParserVersion "2.3.5 (Release)" in muParserDef.h; the commit is the v2.3.5 tag. The directory holds upstream include/ and src/ flattened into one directory, plus LICENSE and README.md. Every file was compared with the tag: all are identical except for the local change below, apart from line endings (muParserDLL.cpp, muParserError.cpp and README.md use CRLF at the tag and are stored with LF here).

local_changes.details: muParserFixes.h defines MUPARSER_STATIC, so that API_EXPORT_CXX is empty and Windows builds do not mark the classes dllimport (from 2dc805326, "Fix windows build"). Upstream sets MUPARSER_STATIC from its own CMakeLists.txt for static builds, which SatDump does not use.

libraries.notes: Updated in #284 from a master snapshot taken after v2.3.2 (upstream 11410c968cb5ecf20f9a898b83af91984e8307d4, 2021-06-07, which reports "2.3.3 (Development Build)"; matched by diffing upstream history, identical apart from the MUPARSER_STATIC change). v2.3.6-rc2 is a release candidate and was not used. Behaviour changes that SatDump can see: the maximum expression length grows from 5000 to 20000 characters, and rnd() is a new built-in function (uniform random number in [0, 1)); a token named rnd without parentheses is still treated as a variable. The bitwise & and | operators of mu::ParserInt now have separate precedences; SatDump only uses mu::Parser, which does not define them. README.rst became README.md upstream. muParserDLL.cpp (the C interface, compiled but not used by SatDump) changes the signature of mupDefineInfixOprt().

libraries.version_source: No releases. TextEditor.h matches upstream master (ca2f9f1, 2025-11-24) apart from the include path (hence 11282 bytes against 11276). TextEditor.cpp differs from master in 8 lines: the local changes below, plus master's isspace()/isalnum() '!= 0' comparisons and PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_NoTabStop) call, which the copy lacks. So the copy predates those upstream changes; the exact commit is not known.

local_changes.details: Both files include "imgui/imgui.h" instead of "imgui.h"; TextEditor.cpp defines IMGUI_DEFINE_MATH_OPERATORS and stubs out PushAllowKeyboardFocus/PopAllowKeyboardFocus ("TODOIMGUI") for the newer Dear ImGui.

libraries.notes: Used by the dataset handler's script editor. Found in the PR #330 review; not covered by #273 to #300.

libraries.name: IconFontCppHeaders (Font Awesome 5 icon header)
libraries.version_source: Not recorded; a generated header.
libraries.notes: Shipped with imgui-notify. Only needs an update if the bundled Font Awesome font changes.

libraries.name: bzip2
libraries.version_source: BZ_VERSION in bz_version.h. 1.1.0 is the development line of the GitLab repository, not a release (the latest release is 1.0.8).

local_changes.details: bzlib_utils.h (listed as a SatDump file) holds a modified copy of BZ2_bzBuffToBuffDecompress that also returns the bytes consumed.

libraries.notes: Upstream nearly inactive; no release since 1.0.8 (2019). resources/credits.md links https://github.com/libarchive/bzip2, a mirror.

libraries.name: VOLK volk_alloc.hh
libraries.version_source: Not recorded in the file. Byte-identical to include/volk/volk_alloc.hh at this commit (2020-03-17); upstream changed the file again in 2022 (SPDX header) and in January 2023 (d732e3e, relicensed to LGPL-3.0-or-later).
libraries.notes: Only used when the system VOLK lacks volk_alloc.hh (VOLK 1.x, VOLK_HAS_ALLOC check in src-core/CMakeLists.txt), and always on Android. Kept only for old VOLK, so it does not need to follow upstream. This copy predates VOLK's January 2023 relicensing, so its header (and license) is still GPL-3.0-or-later.

libraries.name: SDRplay API headers
libraries.version_source: SDRPLAY_API_VERSION in sdrplay_api.h. Distributed with SDRplay's closed-source API installer, no repository.
libraries.notes: Headers only; the API library is loaded at run time (dynload.h). Update when a new API version adds devices or calls SatDump needs.

libraries.name: Aaronia RTSA API header (cut-down)
libraries.version_source: Not recorded. A simplified copy of Aaronia's <aaroniartsaapi.h>, so the plugin builds without the API installed (the library is loaded at run time, dynload.h).

local_changes.details: Reduced to the declarations SatDump uses.

libraries.notes: Distributed with Aaronia's closed-source RTSA API. Update when SatDump needs calls or constants that are missing.

libraries.name: stb_truetype / stb_textedit / stb_rect_pack (Dear ImGui imstb_ copies for text rendering)
libraries.version_source: The three files are identical (ignoring line endings) to the imstb_*.h files of the Dear ImGui v1.89 tag. They are ImGui's modified copies of https://github.com/nothings/stb.
libraries.notes: Used by src-core/image/text.*, independently of the Dear ImGui core (which has its own, newer copies). An identical, unused duplicate in src-core/image/font_lib was removed (#332).

libraries.version_source: Not recorded: LA_VERSION is declared in version.h but its generated definition is not in the tree. Copyright 2018-2021 suggests a 2.1.x-era copy.

libraries.name: CharLS

libraries.version_source: Not recorded (copyright EUMETSAT 2015-2023).
libraries.notes: EUMETSAT's FCI JPEG-LS HDF5 filter. The upstream repository URL is not recorded in the files and still has to be confirmed. Found in the sweep; not covered by #273 to #300.

libraries.name: libmirisdr
libraries.version_source: Not recorded. Has mirisdr_set_hw_flavour (libmirisdr-4 lineage) and mirisdr_set_bias; which fork it came from (https://github.com/f4exb/libmirisdr-4, https://github.com/ericek111/libmirisdr-5 or another) is not recorded.

local_changes.details: mirisdr_open_fd (Android USB file descriptor) is probably a local addition.

libraries.notes: resources/credits.md names libmirisdr-4 (https://github.com/f4exb/libmirisdr-4), but the copy has not been compared with it. Only libmirisdr.c is compiled; it #includes the other .c files. Found in the sweep; not covered by #273 to #300.

libraries.name: librfnm
libraries.version_source: No version in the files. librfnm.cpp is closest to upstream src/librfnm.cpp at this commit (2024-05-28, "release interfaces on close"): the 47 differing lines are the local changes below. librfnm/librfnm.h differs in 6 lines and librfnm_api.h is reformatted, so the base is not certain. Imported by SatDump commit d9a68c72a (2024-10-10, "Include old librfnm, as new one is still giving some trouble"). Upstream has since been restructured (src/api, src/core, include/librfnm/device.h ...).

local_changes.details: librfnm.cpp: spdlog calls replaced by printf, the include made relative, <cstring>/<algorithm>/<chrono> added, and one condition-variable wait predicate replaced with a constant. librfnm.h: #include <chrono> added (twice), LIBRFNM_MIN_RX_BUFCNT 1000 -> 500 and LIBRFNM_RX_RECOMB_BUF_LEN 400 -> 300. librfnm_api.h: reformatted.

libraries.notes: Built into the rfnm_sdr_support plugin by its file(GLOB_RECURSE *.cpp) when libusb-1.0 is found; the system-library lookup (pkg_check_modules(RFNM rfnm)) is commented out, so this copy is always used. Upstream added its MPL-2.0 LICENSE.md on 2025-06-09, after the commit this copy is based on, which had no license file. Found in the PR #330 review; not covered by #273 to #300.

libraries.name: serial (William Woodall)
libraries.version_source: Not recorded (the \version 0.1 in serial.h is also in every upstream release).

local_changes.details: Directory layout flattened (no include/serial/).

libraries.name: SDR++ server client
libraries.version_source: Not recorded; adapted from sdrpp_server_source/src (see README.txt).

libraries.version_source: Not recorded; the headers say "adapted from https://github.com/drmpeg/gr-dvbs2rx".

libraries.name: moodycamel readerwriterqueue (circular buffer and atomicops)
libraries.version_source: Not recorded. Each file differs from current master by under 10 lines.

libraries.version_source: Not recorded. imgui_sw.cpp differs from current master by about 20 lines.

libraries.notes: Dual-licensed to the public domain and a permissive grant (see the header). Upstream inactive since 2022. Found in the sweep.

libraries.name: maidenhead
libraries.version_source: Not recorded. maidenhead.c differs substantially from upstream master.

libraries.notes: Upstream inactive since 2021. Found in the sweep.

libraries.name: GDAL thin plate spline
libraries.version_source: Not recorded (copyright 2004 VIZRT, 2008-2014 Even Rouault).

local_changes.details: thinplatespline.* are extracted from GDAL alg/thinplatespline.* with the GDAL helpers they need copied in; projection/utils/tps_transform.cpp is GDAL's TPS transformer code, modified for SatDump (its header says so; tps_transform.h is SatDump's interface). libraries.version_source: Not recorded.

libraries.name: GIMP image algorithms (hue-saturation, adaptive despeckle)

libraries.version_source: Not recorded (copyright 2020 SolarSoft Consortium).

libraries.name: NRL SOHO LASCO/EIT reconstruction software (RECON.C)
libraries.version_source: Not recorded. Header: MODULE NAME RECON.C, "Reconstruction (De-Compression) Software for SOHO LASCO/EIT", Mitchell R Grunes (ATSC/NRL) and Karl Hoppel (NRL), dated 07/11/96. rice_decomp.h says it is a port of SOHO's ricerecon64 that works from memory and does not leak on errors.

local_changes.details: Ported by SatDump to decode from memory and to clean up on errors (see rice_decomp.h).

libraries.notes: Used for STEREO SECCHI image decompression. No license notice in the files and no public upstream location found; the original was NRL ground software for SOHO (1996). Found in the third PR #330 review.

libraries.version_source: Not recorded. The headers say "DifferentialDecoder ... Created on: 25/01/2017, Author: Lucas Teske, Modified by Aang23"; upstream's file is src/differentialencoding.cpp.

libraries.notes: Upstream inactive since 2020. src-core/common/codings/randomization.h ("CCSDS Derandomizer, adapted from SatHelper") and src-core/common/codings/reedsolomon/reedsolomon.h ("based on SatHelper's implementation") are smaller adaptations and are not listed. Found in the third PR #330 review.

libraries.name: labrador-ldpc (C++ port)
libraries.version_source: Not recorded. The code is a C++ translation of upstream's Rust src/decoder.rs, src/encoder.rs and src/codes/{compact_generators,compact_parity_checks}.rs (same structure and names, e.g. decode_ms, decode_ms_working_u8_len, and upstream's comments such as "Rename working_u8 to ui_sgns." and the commented-out assert_eq! lines). Added to SatDump in 06f20e557 (2025-09-13); upstream's last commit is 61be8c07 (2024-02-22, latest tag v1.2.1), so it was probably ported from that, but this is not confirmed.

local_changes.details: Rust translated to C++ (decoder templated on the LLR type); merge upstream fixes by hand.

libraries.notes: Found in the third PR #330 review.

libraries.name: GNU Radio volk_k7_r2 generic Viterbi kernel
libraries.version_source: Not recorded (copyright 2014 Free Software Foundation).

libraries.version_source: Sources named in the files: FindZSTD.cmake from https://github.com/facebook/folly (CMake/FindZstd.cmake), FindOpenGLES2.cmake modified from https://github.com/freeminer/freeminer, FindJemalloc.cmake from https://gist.github.com/Lewiscowles1986/225a10154637d18d6187147015c8d0f7.

libraries.name: Bundled fonts
libraries.version_source: Versions not recorded. Sources from resources/credits.md: Roboto (https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto), 3270 Nerd Font (https://www.nerdfonts.com/) merged with Roboto into font.ttf, Liberation Serif, Perfect DOS VGA 437 and PX Sans Nouveaux (dafont.com). GloriaHallelujah-Regular.ttf, IBMPlexSans-*-FAT.ttf, NotoSansSC-Medium.ttf, monospace.medium.ttf and px_sans_nouveaux-FAT.ttf are not in the credits.
libraries.license: various, not recorded in the tree

local_changes.details: font.ttf merges Roboto with 3270 Nerd Font; the *-FAT.ttf files are probably merged/extended variants.

libraries.notes: Data files, not code. No font license files are shipped with them and their licenses are not recorded; this needs checking separately. Roboto-Regular.png is not a font.

libraries.name: Catch2
libraries.version_source: SATDUMP_CATCH2_FETCH_VERSION in tests/CMakeLists.txt (FetchContent of tag v3.16.1).
libraries.notes: Not vendored: a system Catch2 >= 3.4.0 is used if present, otherwise 3.16.1 is fetched at configure time. The path is where the version is set.

not_tracked: android/deps is a git submodule (https://github.com/SatDump/Android-Dependencies) with prebuilt Android dependencies; it is versioned by its submodule commit, not by this file.
docs/res is a git submodule (SatDump Resources).

Small fragments inside SatDump's own files are not listed individually: GNU Radio (convolutional coding, src-core/common/dsp/filter/firdes.h, src-core/common/codings/lfsr.h, ...; see also gnuradio-viterbi-k7), SDR++ (the DSP stream implementation, src-core/common/dsp/resamp/power_decim/plans.h, src-core/common/wav.cpp), LeanDVB (plugins/dvb_support/codings/dvb-s2/s2_scrambling.*) and Scytale-C (https://bitbucket.org/scytalec/scytalec; the STD-C syncword in plugins/inmarsat_support/stdc/decode_utils.cpp and the STD-C packet formats).
cmake/FindAVX.cmake, FindNEON.cmake and FindSSE41.cmake carry no origin or license.

resources/credits.md also credits libraries that are linked from the system rather than vendored (curl, fftw3, hdf5, jemalloc, libpng, nng, PortAudio, VOLK, zlib, glfw3, OpenGL ES/EGL and the SDR vendor libraries); those need no entry.
